dataset_name: INSYT Corporate Government Research-Organization Job Intelligence Dataset — Batch 01

scope.important_scope_note: এই dataset-এ 'all jobs' বলতে আপনার দেওয়া recruitment circular/notice-গুলোতে পাওয়া সব distinct job category বোঝানো হয়েছে। এটি প্রতিষ্ঠানগুলোর sanctioned-post organogram-এর প্রতিটি পদ নয়। Salary হলো National Pay Scale/basic pay scale; take-home salary নয়। 'skills_after_joining' এবং কিছু 'career_insight' circular-এর সরাসরি requirement নয়—job function ও প্রতিষ্ঠানের research/work structure থেকে INSYT Corporate-এর জন্য inferred competency।
source_priority: reliable web reproduction of the same circular
inference for post-joining skills and career intelligence

skill_bundles.research: Research methodology, literature review, experimental thinking, scientific documentation and research ethics.
skill_bundles.agri_research: Agronomy, crop science, soil/crop management, field experimentation and agricultural technology depending on role.
skill_bundles.statistics_data: Statistics, data cleaning, Excel/spreadsheets, statistical interpretation and progressively R/Python/SQL for advanced roles.
skill_bundles.scientific_lab: Laboratory safety, sample handling, measurement, documentation, instrument handling and quality control.
skill_bundles.field: Field survey, trial management, crop observation, farmer interaction, field data collection and reporting.
skill_bundles.scientific_writing: Technical report writing, scientific paper structure, citation management, presentation and documentation.
skill_bundles.engineering: Engineering fundamentals, drawings/specifications, equipment maintenance, troubleshooting and safety.
skill_bundles.computer: Computer operation, MS Office, word processing, spreadsheets, data entry, file management and digital workflow.
skill_bundles.typing: Bangla/English typing, word processing and data-entry accuracy.
skill_bundles.admin: Office administration, records, correspondence, documentation, scheduling and government-office workflow.
skill_bundles.finance: Accounting basics, vouchers, ledgers, budgeting, audit documentation and financial controls.
skill_bundles.statistics: Descriptive/inferential statistics, data management, survey design and quantitative interpretation.
skill_bundles.communication: Professional communication, public relations, report writing, presentation and stakeholder communication.
skill_bundles.library: Cataloguing, classification, information retrieval, digital library systems and research-information management.
skill_bundles.mechanical: Mechanical systems, machinery operation, preventive maintenance and troubleshooting.
skill_bundles.electrical: Electrical systems, wiring, equipment maintenance, diagnostics and electrical safety.
skill_bundles.civil: Civil construction, measurement, estimation, drawings, site supervision and construction safety.
skill_bundles.vehicle: Safe vehicle operation, maintenance awareness, route discipline and equipment handling.
skill_bundles.trade: Role-specific hands-on trade skill, tool safety, preventive maintenance and practical troubleshooting.
skill_bundles.support: Workplace discipline, safety, cleaning/handling procedures, teamwork and institutional support operations.
skill_bundles.leadership: Team coordination, planning, supervision, decision-making and institutional management.
skill_bundles.nuclear_agri: Nuclear/agricultural science awareness, laboratory discipline, radiation-safety awareness where applicable, crop improvement and scientific data handling.
skill_bundles.jute: Jute agronomy, fibre science, textile physics, chemistry, breeding, field experimentation and post-harvest/industrial applications.
skill_bundles.rice: Rice breeding, agronomy, soil-water management, plant pathology, entomology, biotechnology, farm machinery, agricultural economics and statistics.
skill_bundles.sugarcrop: Sugarcane/sugarcrop agronomy, breeding, biotechnology, entomology, soil/nutrient management, sugar chemistry and socioeconomic/field research.
skill_bundles.tea: Tea agronomy, plantation management, tea research, soil science, botany, statistics, agricultural economics and tea-industry management.

highest_value_job_families_for_insyt_cor.why: This is the dominant research-career family across the six organizations.
Agricultural Economics appears directly or through research/planning functions and is especially explicit in BRRI and BTRI.
Statistics and data-processing roles are recurring and directly connected to research.
Field assistants, scientific assistants, fieldmen and agricultural overseers are recurring operational research roles.
Every research institute requires engineering, machinery, infrastructure or maintenance personnel.

key_insyt_corporate_product_logic.candidate_profile: Degree + major + CGPA/class + experience + certificates + technical skills + soft skills + district + age + research interests.
key_insyt_corporate_product_logic.job_profile: Organization + department + job family + title + grade + salary + vacancy + education + experience + mandatory skills + preferred skills + district restrictions + selection method + date.
key_insyt_corporate_product_logic.matching_engine: Hard-filter eligibility first; then calculate skill match; then calculate degree/domain match; then calculate experience match; finally generate missing-skill learning plan.
key_insyt_corporate_product_logic.skill_gap_engine: Example: B.Sc Agricultural Economics → BRRI Data Analyst → hard eligibility check → Statistics gap → R/Python gap → Data Processing gap → Experimental Design gap → Research Data Management gap → personalized course sequence.
key_insyt_corporate_product_logic.post_joining_engine: After matching a job, INSYT Corporate should not stop at 'get hired'; it should generate a 90-day and 12-month competency roadmap for succeeding after joining.
key_insyt_corporate_product_logic.career_graph: Degree → eligible organizations → eligible job families → current vacancies → required skills → courses → projects → research portfolio → application → exam → interview → joining → post-joining competency → promotion pathway.

strongest_opportunity_for_user_profile.note: For an Agricultural Economics/Data/Research-oriented candidate, BRRI, BTRI, BSRI and BARI are particularly valuable because the supplied/web-verified material contains explicit economics, statistics, data, research and field-research pathways.

high_confidence: BARI 2026 job list, salary and core eligibility
medium_confidence: Some historical BSRI job titles where the scanned image required visual interpretation
low_confidence_items: BSRI 2023 row 17 exact job title is not cleanly machine-readable from the supplied scan and is intentionally marked scan-confirmation-required rather than silently guessed.
Older BTRI image-only notices contain additional historical recruitment information but were not merged into the main normalized job list where the exact title/grade could not be reliably recovered.
data_quality.important_rule_for_production: INSYT Corporate should store source_original_text separately from normalized_title. Never overwrite an ambiguous circular term with a guessed job title. Store OCR text, normalized title, confidence and source page.

critical_product_decision: INSYT Corporate should treat recruitment circulars as structured career-intelligence data rather than simply as job listings. The valuable product is the chain: 'Who hires → for what role → with what degree → at what grade/salary → with what eligibility → with what skills → what should I learn before applying → what will I need after joining → what career path follows.'
